question.instructions: Look at comment {{id}} in state.comments. It appears under the YouTube video titled 'Dune: Part Three | Official Trailer' by Warner Bros. Pictures. Does this comment reveal a specific plot event, character fate, ending, twist, or result that a viewer who has not yet watched the work would not want to know in advance? Reactions, opinions, praise, jokes and questions that do not disclose concrete events are NOT spoilers.

criteria.true: Reveals a concrete plot event, death, twist, ending, or result.
criteria.false: Opinion, reaction, praise, joke, question, or discussion without disclosing concrete events.
